title: SpongeBob's Roman Party
description: SpongeBob SquarePants stands in the center wearing a brown hat with a laurel wreath, his right eye replaced by a detailed skull. He points upward with one hand while holding a pencil in the other. To the left is a cracked classical stone column wrapped in a floral wreath, with a golden lyre floating nearby. Red and brown hands from above place a laurel wreath on his head as spotlights shine down and a speech bubble reads 'PARTY OVER HERE!'.
